caps.blockedTitle: This browser cannot run the editor
caps.blockedHelp: Use the latest Chrome or Edge. The app must be opened over https or localhost, and the server must send the Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy and Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy headers (see docs/DEPLOY.md).

items.secureContext: The page is not on a secure connection (https or localhost), so the browser disables its video features.
items.webcodecs: WebCodecs (video decoding and encoding) is not available.
items.h264: H.264 video encoding is not supported, so exporting is impossible.
items.opfs: Browser file storage (OPFS) is not available, so media cannot be imported.
items.isolation: The server does not send the COOP/COEP headers; automatic subtitles will run slower.
items.webgpu: WebGPU is not available; automatic subtitles will run on the CPU, more slowly.
items.saveDialog: The save dialog is not available; exports are saved as downloads.

errors.memory: Not enough memory. Lower the export resolution or close other tabs.

onboarding.title: Welcome to the video editor 👋
onboarding.step1: Drop video, audio or image files onto the Media panel.
onboarding.step2: Drag them onto the timeline; split (S), trim and move them.
onboarding.step3: Add titles with "T+ Text", and create or auto-generate subtitles in the Subtitles tab.
onboarding.step4: Make an MP4 with the Export button.
onboarding.sampleCue2: زیرنویس‌ها را در زبانه «زیرنویس» ویرایش کنید.
